external_gate: Augmented weighted Stage3 strictly greater than both baseline and identical threefold replication
public_same17_gate: Augmented weighted Stage3 greater than or equal to both baseline and identical threefold replication
action_if_pass: Prepare a separate final refit using all 23 external routes plus 50 public sparse labels and the unchanged fixed scale augmentation
action_if_fail: Do not refit or adopt the scale candidate
final_refit_caveat: The six external validation routes will be included only after selection; their prior scores are not an independent evaluation of the final refitted model
